Bash(gh issue create --title "Fix Mapster BudgetId to Guid mapping test failure" --body "$\(cat <<''EOF''
## Problem
The test `BudgetModelTests.Map_From_Aggregate_To_Model_Successfully` is failing due to a Mapster configuration issue.

## Error
```
Mapster.CompileException: Cannot convert immutable type, please consider using ''MapWith'' method to create mapping
source=BlazingBudget.Domain.Aggregates.Budgets.BudgetId
destination=System.Guid
```

## Solution
Configure Mapster to handle strongly-typed ID conversions:
- Add a `MapWith` configuration for `BudgetId` → `Guid`
- Consider creating a global Mapster configuration for all strongly-typed IDs

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] All tests pass
- [ ] Mapster configuration handles all strongly-typed IDs in the project
EOF
\)")
